Our Mission

Community empowerment and sustainable development, with special attention to pastoralist and rural communities.

Our Approach

Education, livelihoods, environmental care, health and culture, working together as one community.

Who We Serve

Young people, women and vulnerable groups across pastoralist and rural areas.

Our Story

Empowering Communities, Sustaining Our Future

Ole Kasi Foundation focuses on community empowerment and sustainable development, with special attention to pastoralist and rural communities.

We support access to education, help families build sustainable incomes, protect the environment, improve community health, and celebrate and protect Maasai cultural heritage while fostering unity and progressive community leadership.

Discover More

Our Work

What shapes our work

Education & Youth Empowerment

Access to quality education, skills training and leadership development for young people.

Learn more →

Livelihoods & Economic Empowerment

Helping families, especially women and youth, build sustainable incomes through skills, small businesses and value-addition.

Learn more →

Environmental Stewardship & Climate Resilience

Conservation, climate-smart practices and sustainable natural resource management in pastoralist areas.

Learn more →

Community Health & Social Well-being

Basic health awareness, water and sanitation, and social protection for vulnerable groups.

Learn more →

Cultural Preservation & Community Cohesion

Celebrating and protecting Maasai cultural heritage while fostering unity and progressive leadership.

Learn more →
